fields.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Corki''' {{tip|dashes}} to the target location and drops bombs that leave up to 3 blazing patches along his path, depending on the distance traveled. Each patch lasts {{fd|2.5}} seconds.
fields.description2: Enemies within the patches are dealt {{as|magic damage}} every {{fd|0.5}} seconds, lingering for 1 second.

fields.description3: ''{{ai|Gatling Gun|Corki}} can be cast during the dash.''
